versions.content: If the RAM Test execution status is RAMTST_EXECUTION_STOPPED or RAMTST_EXECUTION_SUSPENDED , the function RamTst_RunPartialTest shall set the execution status to RAMTST_EXECUTIO N_RUNNING during the test, and after the test shall set it back to the previous state (the state when the function was called) .

If the RAM Test execution status is RAMTST_EXECUTION_STOPPED or RAMTST_EXECUTION_SUSPENDED , the function RamTst_RunPartialTest shall set the execution status to RAMTST_EXE CUTION_RUNNING during the test, and after the test shall set it back to the previous state (the state when the function was called) .

If the RAM Test execution status is RAMTST_EXECUTION_STOPPED or RAMTST_EXECUTION_SUSPENDED , the function RamTst_RunPartialTest shall set the execution status to RAMTST_EXECUTION_RUNNING during the test, and af ter the test shall set it back to the previous state (the state when the function was called) .
